_comment: Conformance fixture: unavailable ref returns readiness/snapshot-resolution outcome, not not_found (ADR-0010 §Branch Visibility Boundary)

scenarios.name: unavailable_ref
scenarios.description: Requested ref does not exist locally. Must return RefNotAvailable, not NotFound.
scenarios.explanation: RefNotAvailable means the snapshot could not be resolved — it was never inspected. NotFound means the snapshot WAS inspected and the target was absent.

scenarios.name: hosted_only_scope
scenarios.description: Ref requires hosted/team graph visibility not available locally.
scenarios.explanation: Hosted-only scope refs return a readiness failure. They are never collapsed into not_found.

scenarios.name: inspected_absent_target
scenarios.description: Snapshot IS available and inspected, but the target file/symbol is absent.
scenarios.explanation: not_found is verified negative evidence: the snapshot was inspected and the target was absent. This is distinct from RefNotAvailable.
